item.title: Network of Scottish X accounts go dark amid Iran blackout
item.description:
📝 Network of Scottish X accounts go dark amid Iran blackout Iran Scottish independence Twitter/X Politics Technology Scotland By Josh Pizzuto-Pomaco Reporter Share 0 Comments The accounts are believed to be linked to Iran. Industry publication UK Defence Journal, which has tracked the accounts for months, said that multiple X accounts claiming to be supporters of Scottish independence have ceased activity. The accounts went silent after the internet was cut amid protests in Iran.
🔗 Read more: https://www.heraldscotland.com/news/25759181.network-scottish-x-accounts-go-dark-amid-iran-blackout/
